svg.title: Choosing who and what on the Psynergy screen
svg.desc: The Psynergy screen in Xian, step by step. First, "Whose Psynergy?": the hand picks Isaac in the party row. Second, "Which Psynergy?": his list, Cure, Cure Well and Move, with Cure picked. Third, without waiting a frame, the screen works out how Cure is used: on one member, so it asks whom; Psynergy for the whole party would be used at once, and Psynergy for the field closes the menu for the field to cast. Fourth, "Use it on whom?": the hand picks Garet. Fifth, the Psynergy is used: Garet's HP rises from 60 to 139 of 187, Isaac pays 3 PP, from 61 to 58, the screen says "You recovered HP!", and the list comes back.
svg.text: ISAAC CASTS CURE ON GARET, IN XIAN
